castlenavigation: Name of the special page listing every Castle room and its exits.
castlenavigation-summary: Totals above the room table. $1 is the number of rooms in the navigation map, $2 the number of rooms with at least one destination that does not exist, $3 the total number of such destinations.
castlenavigation-col-room: Table column heading: the room's key in the navigation map.
castlenavigation-col-page: Table column heading: whether a wiki page with the room's title exists.
castlenavigation-col-exits: Table column heading: how many destinations the room links to.
castlenavigation-col-broken: Table column heading: how many of those destinations do not exist.
castlenavigation-col-status: Table column heading: plain-language summary of the room's health.
castlenavigation-col-slot: Table column heading: the numbered placeholder ({{[[1]]}}, {{[[2]]}} ...) this destination fills in the room's prose.
castlenavigation-col-destination: Table column heading: the page title this exit links to.
castlenavigation-col-shownas: Table column heading: the link's display text, when it differs from the page title.
castlenavigation-status-ok: Shown when every destination of a room exists.
castlenavigation-status-nopage: Shown when the navigation map has an entry but no wiki page carries that title.
castlenavigation-status-brokentargets: Shown when destinations do not exist. $1 is a comma-separated list of the missing page titles.
castlenavigation-prose-heading: Heading above the room's exit sentence, with destinations replaced by numbered placeholders.
castlenavigation-destinations-heading: Heading above the table of destinations that fill the room's placeholders.
castlenavigation-noexits: Shown on a room's page when it links nowhere.
castlenavigation-noroom: Error shown when the requested room is not in the navigation map. $1 is the requested room key.
castlenavigation-backtoindex: Link text returning to the list of all rooms.
castlenavigation-noentry-heading: Heading above the list of pages that render a navigation tag but have no entry in the map.
castlenavigation-noentry-empty: Shown when that list is empty. Notes that the list is populated as pages are parsed, so an empty list is not proof of completeness.
nfpar-tracking-category-no-entry: {{tracking category name}} Category collecting pages that render a navigation tag with no matching entry in the navigation map.
nfpar-tracking-category-no-entry-desc: {{tracking category desc}} Explains why a page is in the category.
